decisions.title: MCP server is a separately-deployed sibling service
decisions.rationale: Deploy independently from services/api. Do NOT wire services/mcp-server into docs/config/project-commands.yaml::preflight of the main API. It ships as its own deployable with its own pyproject.toml, own tests, own commands. Root docs/config/project-commands.yaml may add an mcp_server:* namespace or leave it entirely out (PLAN decision).

risks.title: Profile YAML location drift
risks.summary: Story AC-2 reads '.harness/profile.yaml', but ING-10 moves activity/artifact sources to '.harness/program.yaml' (committed)
risks.mitigation: Story logic should accept BOTH layouts gracefully (check program.yaml first, fall back to profile.yaml for local dev), OR explicitly gate on ING-10's completion.
risks.resolution: Filesystem reality settles this: profile.yaml is IDENTITY ONLY (email/name/role, gitignored, per-machine) — no files[], no artifacts{}. Committed program.yaml holds the canonical files[] (line 84) and artifacts{} (line 110). Tool reads program.yaml for both push_activity and push_artifacts. Story text is pre-ING-10 stale — correct in PLAN: replace every '.harness/profile.yaml' reference in ACs with '.harness/program.yaml'. Optional: read profile.yaml for identity attribution logging only (email/name), NOT for source paths.

risks.title: Glob pattern / JSON path injection
risks.summary: User-controlled glob/path in profile.yaml is passed unsanitized to filesystem/JSON resolver
risks.mitigation: Input validation: glob patterns must not contain .., must stay within workspace_root; JSON paths must not contain $ or @ or complex expressions. Enforce via explicit allowlist or sandboxed path resolution.
risks.note: HIGH risk stands; PLAN must define explicit allowlist for glob patterns (no '..' traversal, workspace_root scoped) and JSON key/field names (no expressions).

risks.title: Token secret handling
risks.summary: Env-var leak (e.g., env printed in logs, leaked in error output)
risks.mitigation: Establish MCP server's logging config to suppress env-var printing. Review all exception handlers to ensure token is never in extra dict passed to logger.
risks.note: HIGH risk stands; PLAN must include logging-config discipline + token-absence-in-logs test assertion.

resolved_clarifications.title: FastMCP vs mcp-python library selection
resolved_clarifications.question: The story and PRD both reference 'FastMCP' and a 'reference implementation' in agentrise_mcp, but do not name the exact library/version. Is this fastapi-mcp (a FastAPI plugin), the standalone mcp library from Anthropic, or a third-party agentrise-specific fork?
resolved_clarifications.impact: Low if a reference implementation exists to copy; HIGH if team must build FastMCP integration from scratch.
resolved_clarifications.resolution_path: Provide link to reference GitHub repository or PyPI package name in story's PLAN phase.
resolved_clarifications.resolution: Use the standalone FastMCP Python package (https://pypi.org/project/fastmcp/ — jlowin/fastmcp, v2.x). NOT fastapi-mcp (a FastAPI plugin) and NOT the low-level anthropic mcp SDK. FastMCP provides @server.tool() decorator + streamable HTTP transport out of the box, matching AC-1.
